SELECT id FROM connector_config WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND connector = #{connector} AND id = #{configId} AND config_version = #{configVersion} AND enabled = TRUE AND endpoint IS NOT NULL AND endpoint <> '' AND external_list_id IS NOT NULL AND external_list_id <> '' AND credential_ref IS NOT NULL AND credential_ref <> '' FOR SHARE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO connector_config (workspace_id, connector, endpoint, external_list_id, credential_ref, credential_last4, enabled, created_by_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{connector}, #{endpoint}, #{externalListId}, #{credentialRef}, #{credentialLast4}, #{enabled}, #{createdById}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE endpoint = VALUES(endpoint), external_list_id = VALUES(external_list_id), credential_ref = VALUES(credential_ref), credential_last4 = VALUES(credential_last4), enabled = VALUES(enabled), config_version = config_version + 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM connector_config WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND connector = #{connector}
